title: Marketing site
description: Adds the project's one-page marketing site for GitHub Pages, built from @openstuff-dev/ui/marketing.css.

name.description: The project's name as people read it, e.g. OpenLedger.
name.x-prompt: What is the project called (e.g. OpenLedger)?

tagline.description: The hero headline: what it does, in a few words.

domain.description: Where it is served. Defaults to <name without Open>.openstuff.dev, e.g. ledger.openstuff.dev.

repository.description: The GitHub repository URL. Defaults to this repository's origin.

appUrl.description: The hosted app, e.g. https://ledger.openstuff.app. Without one, the buttons point to self-hosting.

primaryColor.description: The project's primary colour, as hex. Defaults to the one in apps/web/tokens.config.json.

glyph.description: The shape inside the project's mark. Pick one no other OpenStuff project uses.
